newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHENS BOURSE SEEKS CAP MKT COMMISSION ADVICE ON MAGRIZOS.
newsitem.headline: ATHENS BOURSE SEEKS CAP MKT COMMISSION ADVICE ON MAGRIZOS.

text.p: The Athens bourse authorities decided to seek the advice of the capital markets commission on the share capital of Magrizos whose shares have been suspended from trading, it said in a statement.

The suspension from trading of the Magrizos shares and the likely involvement of some of its major shareholders in the Delta Securities affair were cited as reasons for asking the opinion of the capital markets commission, the bourse said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
